_source: Hand-written to the Messages API response shape (content blocks, stop_reason, usage); not captured from the live API. The advisory and the landing trip come from tests/fixtures/feeds/ (the alert moved to the test day).
description: Trip planning with a species (TA-A2): get_conditions with species=rockfish returns the planning brief (advisory line, no reviewed rockfish row, the landing's trip with its Low label, the closer). The reply leads with the advisory, sends the person to the rules, says the one ladder phrase and ends with the NWS line; the backstop has nothing to do.
message: Worth going out of Morro Bay for rockfish today?

tool_result_contains: "closer":"Check the latest NWS forecast before you go."

content.text: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY posted for today. Today's forecast numbers aren't in yet. I have no reviewed rockfish rule, so check the current CDFW rules: {{link:rules:rockfish}} The landing had Starfire with rockfish last Sun; recent reported activity: Low. Check the latest NWS forecast before you go.
